title: Enabling Tidying Tasks in Robotic Vacuum Cleaners via a Geometry-Induced Self-Locking Deployable Linkage
title_zh: 通过几何诱导自锁可展开连杆实现扫地机器人的整理任务
abstract: Robotic vacuum cleaners must extend their functionality within tight limits on size, cost, and durability. Deployable linkages with few actuators meet these limits, but their backdrivability makes it difficult to hold a load-bearing posture without continuous motor torque. We introduce a two-stage deployable linkage that is self-locking, in the sense used for toggle and singularity-based linkages, through its own geometry: at full deployment an internal three-link subchain approaches a collinear, near-singular configuration where the input--output transmission ratio approaches zero, so that plate loads produce a small residual back-driving torque, absorbed by drive-train friction and a lightweight magnetic detent. A single actuator performs deployment and locking, a passive chassis-mounted trigger releases the lock for retraction, and a second actuator adjusts only the deployment height. We integrate the mechanism into a commercial robotic vacuum cleaner and validate it through a 100-cycle repeatability test, a quasi-static load test in which the locked plate held 50\,N with the motor de-energized, and 140 pushing-type tidying trials on seven household objects against a commercial arm-equipped vacuum robot under a documented protocol. We derive the analytical holding condition and discuss its limits as an intermediate design point between passive compliance and articulated manipulation.
abstract_zh: 扫地机器人必须在尺寸、成本和耐用性的严格限制内扩展功能。少驱动器的可展开连杆满足了这些限制，但其反向驱动性使得在没有连续电机扭矩的情况下难以保持承载姿态。我们引入了一种两阶段可展开连杆，通过其自身几何实现自锁（类似于肘节和基于奇异性的连杆机构）：在完全展开时，内部三连杆子链接近共线、近奇异构型，此时输入-输出传动比趋近于零，因此板负载产生小的残余反向驱动力矩，由驱动系统摩擦和轻质磁性定位器吸收。单个执行器完成展开和锁定，底盘安装的被动触发器释放锁以进行缩回，第二个执行器仅调节展开高度。我们将该机构集成到商用扫地机器人中，并通过100次循环重复性测试、锁定板在电机断电下保持50 N的准静态负载测试，以及在记录协议下对七种家用物品与商用带臂扫地机器人进行的140次推式整理试验进行了验证。我们推导了解析保持条件，并讨论了其作为被动柔顺和关节式操作之间中间设计点的局限性。
tldr_zh: 新型自锁连杆让扫地机器人断电也能承载，完成整理任务。
cover_zh: 断电也能稳稳托住！扫地机器人靠几何自锁搞定整理
